Third-party software notices

The vendored markdown-it.js is markdown-it 14.3.0's published UMD minified bundle, with a local ES module adapter and the sourceMappingURL comment removed. No parser code was changed.
Upstream: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it/tree/14.3.0
Published artifact: https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/-/markdown-it-14.3.0.tgz
Upstream dist/markdown-it.min.js SHA-256: 70fe17bd06c7fa819f03a1ed10957904318103624198845dc893b309bf495e28
Vendored adapter SHA-256: f594b35b7a1a5e831a6b2fcdfbad3369c959695f287e2d17674c9aae7d58de69

Dependency versions below match the release's package-lock.json and the node_modules regions in its unminified dist/markdown-it.js. argparse is a command-line dependency, absent from this browser bundle. Build/dev tools are not shipped.
Release lockfile: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it/blob/14.3.0/package-lock.json
